notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Kithkin Spellduster does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kithkin Spellduster, adding {C}{C}.
Kithkin Spellduster dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Kithkin Spellduster enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kithkin Spellduster.
Repeat.
